List providers: their status, room, runners and scale sets.

## Usage

```console
$ rungar providers ls [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Write JSON. |

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--socket string` | The daemon's socket (default `$RUNGAR_SOCKET`, or `/run/rungar/rungar.sock`). |
